metrics.name: Reactions
metrics.description: How many people reacted to your post. Includes Like, Celebrate, Support, and more.

metrics.name: Comments
metrics.description: The number of comments your post received (including nested replies). Shows when your post is starting conversations, not just getting seen.

metrics.name: Eng. Rate
metrics.description: The percentage of people who interacted with your post compared to how many saw it. Balances views and actions to show how compelling your posts are.

metrics.name: Impressions
metrics.description: How many times your post was shown on screen. This can include multiple views by the same person. Useful for spotting how often your content gets surfaced.

metrics.name: Reach
metrics.description: How many unique people saw your post. Unlike impressions, each person is only counted once. Gives you a sense of how far your content spread.
